UO ARENA - quick demo build
===========================

TO PLAY

  On Windows
    Double-click UOArena.exe

    Windows will probably show a blue "Windows protected your PC" box, because
    this is an unsigned hobby build. Click "More info", then "Run anyway".

  On Linux
    Open a terminal in this folder and run:

      chmod +x UOArena.x86_64
      ./UOArena.x86_64

    (The chmod is only needed once. Some file managers can do it for you under
    Properties > Permissions > Allow executing file as program.)

  Either way, keep every file in this folder together - the program needs the
  .pck file next to it.

  Prefer not to download anything at all? The same game runs in a browser at
  https://sirdeaz.github.io/uo-arena


CONTROLS
  Hold RIGHT MOUSE   walk toward the cursor (you can move while casting)
  1 2 3 4 5          magic arrow / poison / lightning / flamestrike / paralyze
  R                  reset the round
  M                  mute the sound
  Alt+F4 / Ctrl+Q    quit


WHAT AM I LOOKING AT
  You are the blue circle on the left. The red one is a practice dummy that
  casts magic arrow at you on a loop.

  The line between you is the game's actual line-of-sight check. Green means
  there is a clear shot; red means cover is breaking it.

  The faint grid on the ground is one second of running per square, so you can
  judge whether you will reach that tent before the spell lands.

  While someone casts, they speak the spell's words overhead - "Kal Vas Flam"
  is a flamestrike, and it takes 2.5 seconds. That is your warning to get
  behind a tent. The tents are the peaked ones; the lumpy blocks are rocks.
  Both stop spells.


TRY THIS
  1. Stand still in the open and hold 4. You will get interrupted every time.
     Any damage breaks a cast, and there is no refund.

  2. Press 4, then immediately press 3. The flamestrike fizzles into a
     lightning. Listen for it - the fizzle is the falling, sputtering sound,
     and learning to hear it is half of playing this well. Spam it and you
     will cast nothing at all: that is deliberate, and it is also how you bait
     someone into dodging early.

  3. Walk off the middle lane while the dummy is casting. Watch the line turn
     red and its spells stop landing.


This is an early prototype - one arena, one dummy, no multiplayer yet.
